name: NVIDIA NemoClaw
desc: One-command stack that runs OpenClaw assistants with guardrails on your machine.
desc_zh: 一条命令装好的开源栈，在自有机器上带着护栏运行 OpenClaw 助手。
solves: Standing up an always-on agent means assembling a model, a sandbox and a policy engine by hand; NemoClaw installs all three together in one command.
solves_zh: 自己搭一个常驻 agent，要手动拼齐模型、沙箱和策略引擎；NemoClaw 用一条命令把三样一起装好。
best_for: You want a personal agent that keeps running on a desktop or DGX box you control, not in someone else's cloud.
best_for_zh: 想要一个常驻在自己桌面或 DGX 机器上的个人 agent，而不是跑在别人云里。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/ and https://build.nvidia.com/）。 Rule-(b) candidate: announced at GTC on 2026-03-17, before the window, and not in the ledger. The NVIDIA press release itself is dated March 16, 2026 Pacific time per the EETrend translation; the blog page I fetched is headed March 17, 2026, so the date here follows the page I quoted. build.nvidia.com says NemoClaw and the NVIDIA OpenShell runtime it installs are in early preview. 首次公开日期来源：https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/rtx-ai-garage-gtc-2026-nemoclaw/
